# SenXDev

> SenXDev is a custom software development company. We design and build mobile apps, web apps, websites and AI solutions for startups and businesses worldwide (USA, UK, Canada, Australia and more), from our team in Sri Lanka.

Contact: support@senxdev.com · +94 76 358 1264 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/94763581264

## Services
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.senxdev.com/services/custom-software-development): Custom software development services for startups and growing businesses: internal tools, business automation and integrations, built by an offshore team.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.senxdev.com/services/mobile-app-development): Mobile app development company building fast iOS and Android apps for startups and businesses worldwide: MVPs, booking apps, ordering apps and customer apps.
- [Website Development](https://www.senxdev.com/services/web-development): Website development and web design services: fast, SEO-ready business websites, landing pages and ecommerce websites that turn visitors into enquiries.
- [Web App Development](https://www.senxdev.com/services/web-app-development): Web app development services: SaaS platforms, dashboards, booking systems and customer portals that run in any browser, for startups and businesses worldwide.
- [AI Development & Automation](https://www.senxdev.com/services/ai-development): AI solutions for business: AI chatbot development, WhatsApp chatbots and AI automation for small businesses and growing teams worldwide.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.senxdev.com/services/ui-ux-design): UI/UX design services: product design, website redesign and design systems for startups and businesses that want clearer, faster products.

## Automation ideas by business type
- [All business types](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas): Pick your business and see 3 practical automation ideas.
- [Restaurants & cafes](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas/restaurants-cafes): WhatsApp bookings without the back-and-forth; Instant answers to common questions; A review request after every visit.
- [Salons & spas](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas/salons-spas): Book appointments straight from Instagram DMs; Appointment reminders with one-tap confirm; Bring regulars back on time.
- [Clinics](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas/clinics): WhatsApp appointment booking; Reminders and pre-visit forms; Answers to everyday questions.
- [Real estate agencies](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas/real-estate): Reply to every enquiry in minutes; Book viewings without the phone tag; New listings sent to matching buyers.
- [Online stores](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas/online-stores): Order updates customers don't have to ask for; Abandoned cart reminders on WhatsApp; A support assistant for common questions.
- [Retail shops](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas/retail-shops): "Is it in stock?" answered automatically; Low-stock alerts before you run out; A daily sales summary on your phone.
- [Gyms & fitness studios](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas/gyms-fitness): Follow up every trial sign-up; Class bookings and waitlists on WhatsApp; Check in with members who stop coming.
- [Agencies & consultants](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas/agencies-consultants): Client onboarding that runs itself; Meeting notes and follow-ups, drafted for you; Monthly reports put together automatically.
- [Trades & home services](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas/trades-home-services): Collect job details before you quote; Book jobs and send reminders; Friendly invoice reminders.
- [Coaches & training centres](https://www.senxdev.com/ideas/coaches-education): Answer course questions on Instagram; Automatic student onboarding; Weekly student check-ins.
